postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(stdout) == 2 * n and stdout.count('(') == n and stdout.count(')') == n)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'Impossible' or a valid bracket sequence of length 2n with n opening and n closing brackets

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or sum(i - stdout[:i].count(')') for i, c in enumerate(stdout) if c == '(') == k
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'Impossible', the total sum of nestings of all opening brackets equals k
